name: Sangat_Sync
description: A dynamic multi-agent system orchestrating your perfect journey. Supports global trip planning with budget awareness, iterative optimization, parallel research, location disambiguation, and persistent memory.

skills.name: Plan a Global Trip
skills.description: Creates comprehensive trip plans for any destination worldwide with budget, cultural, and seasonal awareness
examples: Plan a day in Mumbai for under ₹5000
Optimize my Delhi itinerary for shortest distances

skills.name: Discover Destinations
skills.description: Searches a curated database of 107 destinations across 23 countries and Google Search for real-time results
examples: What are the top-rated temples in India?
Find affordable activities in Paris under €20

skills.name: Personalized Planning
skills.description: Remembers user preferences (cuisine, interests, budget range) and creates personalized recommendations
examples: I love spicy food and art museums, remember that
Plan my trip based on my saved preferences
